subject.title: member-info fails with "fetch failed" on WSL2 in 2026.6.1 (SSRF fetch guard / undici dispatcher regression)

question: Should this Teams Graph regression be fixed inside the existing SSRF-pinned fetch path, adopted through the broader HTTP egress refactor, or held for fresh WSL2 live reproduction before choosing a repair?
rationale: The source path is clear, but choosing the repair boundary affects SSRF/DNS-pinning security and the broad egress direction, which automation should not decide without maintainer intent.

options.title: Live-reproduce, then patch guarded fetch
options.body: Run a real WSL2 Teams Graph `member-info` call with redacted logs, then land the narrowest fix that preserves the existing guarded-fetch boundary.

options.title: Use the egress refactor as canonical
options.body: Treat the broad HTTP egress refactor as the owner path only after maintainers approve its security model and it proves the Teams Graph scenario.

options.title: Wait for fresher reporter proof
options.body: Keep the issue open but do not schedule repair until a current release or main reproduction shows the failure still occurs.

recommendation.title: Live-reproduce, then patch guarded fetch
recommendation.body: Run a real WSL2 Teams Graph `member-info` call with redacted logs, then land the narrowest fix that preserves the existing guarded-fetch boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly tied to the adjacent pinned-dispatcher compatibility merge and likely to evaluate the security boundary tradeoff.
